import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["payments"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    currency = df["currency"]
    country = df["country"]

    valid_currencies = {"USD", "EUR", "GBP"}

    # Rule evaluation in order; a row is rejected by the FIRST rule it fails.
    cond_r1 = amount.isna()

    cond_r2 = (~cond_r1) & (amount <= 0)

    # SQL "NOT IN" semantics: if currency is NULL, the predicate is UNKNOWN,
    # which does not satisfy the (implicit) "is true" test, so the row does
    # not fail R3 on a NULL currency; evaluation proceeds to R4.
    cond_r3 = (
        (~cond_r1)
        & (~cond_r2)
        & currency.notna()
        & (~currency.isin(valid_currencies))
    )

    cond_r4 = (~cond_r1) & (~cond_r2) & (~cond_r3) & country.isna()

    reject_mask = cond_r1 | cond_r2 | cond_r3 | cond_r4

    reason_code = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="object")
    reason_code[cond_r1] = "AMT_NULL"
    reason_code[cond_r2] = "AMT_NONPOS"
    reason_code[cond_r3] = "CCY_INVALID"
    reason_code[cond_r4] = "CTRY_NULL"

    clean = df.loc[~reject_mask].copy()
    clean["amount"] = clean["amount"].round(2)

    rejects = df.loc[reject_mask].copy()
    rejects["reason_code"] = reason_code[reject_mask]

    clean = clean.reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects = rejects.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "payments_clean": clean,
        "payments_rejects": rejects,
    }
